metadata.title: DocApp
metadata.description: Deposit-based appointment booking for small clinics.

feedback.errorTitle: We could not load this page
feedback.errorDescription: Try again. If the problem continues, contact clinic support.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.description: Sign in to continue to your DocApp account and manage your appointments.
signIn.securityNote: DocApp protects account access with secure authentication.
signIn.helpText: New here? Create an account from the registration page.

signUp.title: Create account
signUp.description: Create an account to manage bookings, appointment status, deposits, and clinic cancellation requests.
signUp.privacyNote: Use this account for appointment management only. Do not enter symptoms, diagnoses, treatment notes, or other medical-record details.

home.title: Booking that clinics can trust
home.description: A focused foundation for clinic booking, appointment deposits, and recoverable Google Calendar sync.

patients.title: For patients
patients.description: Book with a clinic and keep appointment details in one place.
patients.item1: Choose a service and available appointment time
patients.item2: See the deposit due now and remaining clinic balance

clinics.title: For clinics
clinics.description: Create a calmer operational layer around clinic calendars.
clinics.item2: Track deposits, no-shows, and remaining balances
clinics.item3: Keep Google Calendar sync visible and recoverable

homePage.title: Your health, on your schedule.
homePage.subtitle: Book your visit with clear appointment times and deposit details, through a process designed around patient convenience.
homePage.heroImageAlt: Healthcare professional supporting a patient during a clinic visit
homePage.benefitDescription: Clear availability, deposit information, and appointment details without unnecessary complexity.
homePage.closingCtaDescription: View the current clinic schedule and begin your booking in a few clear steps.
homePage.processDescription: Three steps take you from service selection to reviewing your appointment details.
homePage.footerDescription: Convenient appointment booking with clear deposit and clinic balance information.
homePage.footerCopyright: © 2026 Sofia Care Clinic. All rights reserved.

online.title: 24/7 online booking
online.description: Browse available services and begin a booking whenever it is convenient.

deposit.title: Clear deposits
deposit.description: See the deposit due now and the remaining clinic balance before checkout.

privacy.title: Privacy first
privacy.description: Your contact details are used only to manage your appointment.

details.title: Clear appointment details
details.description: Review the selected service, time, deposit, and remaining balance before continuing.

service.title: Choose a service
service.description: Start with the type of visit you need and continue to the available clinic times.

time.title: Pick an available slot
time.description: Select a time shown by the clinic schedule. The full booking flow arrives in the next phases.

deposit.title: Review deposit and details
deposit.description: Before checkout, the app will show the deposit due now and the remaining balance due at the clinic.

deposit.title: Deposit policy
deposit.description: Deposits reserve appointment time and are non-refundable by default when a patient does not attend.

privacy.title: Appointment-only account
privacy.description: Use the app for bookings and appointment status. Do not enter symptoms, diagnoses, treatment notes, or medical-record details.

attendance.title: Clinic attendance
attendance.description: Please arrive on time or contact the clinic if your visit needs attention under the clinic cancellation policy.

booking.title: Book an appointment
booking.description: The accepted three-step booking wizard is now represented as a route foundation. Availability and booking behavior arrive in later phases.

service.title: Service
service.description: Choose the appointment type and provider.

details.title: Details
details.description: Confirm contact details and review the deposit.

admin.title: Operational overview
admin.description: The clinic administration shell is ready for organization-scoped operational features.

operations.title: Operational overview
operations.description: The admin surface will focus on clinic work, not marketing.

configuration.title: Clinic configuration
configuration.description: Settings will stay organization-scoped and access-protected.

staffInvitation.connectedLater: Send a staff invitation through the secure server flow.
staffInvitation.emailError: Enter a valid staff email address.
staffInvitation.serverError: The invitation could not be sent. Check the email and try again.

dashboard.title: Operational dashboard
dashboard.description: This staff dashboard shell is ready for practice summaries and operational workflow cards.

staffMembers.title: Staff Members
staffMembers.description: Manage staff invitations and prepare the staff table for admin-only actions.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: This area will show role-specific clinic notifications without mixing them with audit logs.

logs.title: Logs
logs.description: This placeholder is reserved for future operational log review. Full backend request logging should use external observability after release.

manualBooking.title: Book a manual appointment
manualBooking.description: This area will support authorized staff-created bookings for phone, message, or in-person requests.

settings.title: Booking settings
settings.description: This area will hold admin-managed practice and cabinet booking settings.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: This area will let staff maintain the profile details allowed for their role.

schedule.title: Schedule View
schedule.description: This area will give receptionists a schedule view across cabinets.

patient.title: Your appointments
patient.description: This area is ready for appointment details, status, and cancellation-request features.

appointments.title: Appointments
appointments.description: This area is for appointment management only.

privacy.title: Privacy boundary
privacy.description: Medical-record-like features remain outside the MVP.

support.title: Get the right help
support.description: The support route is ready for clinic and patient contact details when those settings are connected.

booking.title: Clinic booking support
booking.description: Patients should contact the clinic about appointment questions.

product.title: DocApp support
product.description: Clinics can contact DocApp for product assistance.

checkout.foundationDescription: The real order and appointment state will be loaded from the database in the payment phase.
checkout.item1: Status pages never mark orders paid
checkout.item2: Stripe webhooks are the payment source of truth
checkout.item3: Calendar creation happens only after confirmed payment

success.title: Appointment payment received
success.description: This read-only status page will show webhook-confirmed appointment and payment state.

pending.title: Payment is still processing
pending.description: This read-only status page will refresh from local order state without finalizing payment.

cancelled.title: Checkout was cancelled
cancelled.description: The appointment remains subject to server-side expiry and cleanup rules.

expired.title: Checkout has expired
expired.description: Expired pending appointments will become available again through server-side rules.
